description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between trigger words and Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) performance for three different trigger insertion strategies. The x-axis is labeled “trigger” and displays categorical values: “bb”, “mb”, “cf”, “beautiful”, “excellent”, “gorgeous”, “wonderful”, “brilliant”, “stunning”, and “beautifully”. The y-axis is labeled “ASR” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 0.9 with a tick interval of 0.2.  

The first line, representing “start”, is teal with circular markers connected by a solid line; it begins at approximately 0.73 and increases to approximately 0.78 at “beautifully” with a peak at 0.82 at “cf” and a decline to 0.64 at "beautiful". The second line, representing “random”, is orange with x-shaped markers connected by a solid line; it starts at approximately 0.08 and increases to approximately 0.61 at “beautifully”, with a peak at 0.64 at “cf”,  a decline to 0.24 at "mb” and then an increase to 0.42 at “beautiful”. The third line, representing “end”, is purple with diamond-shaped markers connected by a solid line; it begins at approximately 0.44 and rises to a peak of 0.85 at “cf”, before decreasing to 0.74 at “beautifully”, and maintaining a value near 0.76 at “wonderful” and “brilliant”.
